mapper.sql: SELECT ui.`id`, ui.`NAME`, ui.`mobile`, ui.`STATUS` AS user_status, ui.`paper_number`, ui.`update_time`, SUBSTRING(org.`org_path_id`,1,LENGTH(org.`org_path_id`)-1) as org_path_id, org.`org_path_name`, uoc.`serial_number`, uoc.`STATUS` AS `card_status`, uoc.`validity_date` FROM user_info ui LEFT JOIN user_organization uorg ON uorg.user_id = ui.id AND uorg.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN organization org ON org.id = uorg.organization_id AND org.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_one_card uoc ON uoc.user_id = ui.id AND uoc.deleted = 0
